meta.description: spherical-s5 - chris hulsbeck by Quickyman, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from modland's V2 collection (`pub/modules/V2/Quickyman/spherical-s5 - chris hulsbeck.v2m`). 120 BPM, 4:24, 10 tracks. The V2 file's last tick is at 440:14; the song here ends 4 s after the last note (a note held more than 16 s past the last note-on is cut there). This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference).
